intro: Ajeck Rouack offers the ultimate challenge in his series of hunts within northern Stranglethorn Vale. After weeks of tracking an elusive beast, he challenges you to seek out the tiger Sin'Dall and bring back her paw.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the final challenge that I will put forth. We've been tracking an elusive tiger for weeks. We call the beast Sin'Dall. See if you can do what no traveler has done before: hunt down and kill Sin'Dall. Bring me her paw as proof of your accomplishment.
Tracking her down will be no easy task.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes the hunt for Sin'Dall?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most impressive, I do say! You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, friend!
